body.name: Ordinary full-kernel target batch and shared-charge optima
body.construction:
For \(\mathcal D_{\mathrm{ord}}\in\mathfrak D_{\mathrm{AEK}}\), let
\[
 \mathcal Q_{\mathrm{batch}}(S_0)
 =\{Q_{x,s}=P((S_0)_x=s):
 x\in\mathfrak X_{V\setminus S_0},\ s\in\mathfrak X_{S_0}\}
\]
be the finite family of scalar single-world translations.  A physical batch certificate is
\[
 E_{\mathrm{batch}}=(\mathcal P,(E_{\mathrm{sw}}^{x,s})_{x,s}),
\]
where \(\mathcal P\subseteq\Pi\), every protocol represented in \(E_{\mathrm{sw}}^{x,s}\) belongs to \(\mathcal P\), and
\(\operatorname{Acc}_{\mathrm{sw}}(Q_{x,s},E_{\mathrm{sw}}^{x,s};G)=1\) for every \((x,s)\).  These clauses define \(\operatorname{Acc}_{\mathrm{batch}}(E_{\mathrm{batch}})=1\).  Protocols are charged once across the entire batch, and
\[
 \operatorname{Opt}_{\mathrm{batch}}
 =\inf_{E_{\mathrm{batch}}:\operatorname{Acc}_{\mathrm{batch}}(E_{\mathrm{batch}})=1}
   \sum_{S\in\mathcal P(E_{\mathrm{batch}})}\sum_{a\in S}c(a).
\]
For an ordinary collection \(\mathbf B\), duplicate intervention sets are coalesced and
\[
 \operatorname{Opt}_{\mathrm{ord}}
 =\inf_{\mathbf B\text{ ordinary full-kernel identifying}}
   \sum_{B\in\{B_i\}_{\mathrm{distinct}}}\sum_{v\in B}\kappa_v.
\]
Both infima over empty families are \(+\infty\).  Batch acceptance is operational and separate from the scalar optimum \(\operatorname{Opt}_{\mathrm{sw}}\).
